column1: # BK7258 project-owned secureboot XIP staging profile.
# This file is separate from auto_partitions.csv.  The latter remains the
# active v3.1.1.9 development layout until this BK7258 staging chain
# has a recoverable full-image handoff and board validation.
# Geometry follows Beken's public BK7258 secure-boot convention:
#   BL1 ROM -> primary/secondary Manifest + BL2 -> primary_all/secondary_all
# This project does not use TF-M in the current boot-chain phase
# signed application group contains CP NuttX and AP NuttX only.  The official
# Beken tool remains a read-only format reference; repository-owned adapters
# perform the BK7258 CP/AP extension without modifying the SDK.
# Do not feed this profile to pack_dual_image.py.
# The public BK7236 example places sys_rf/sys_net/easyflash before TF-M.  This
# staging profile deliberately retains the v3.1.1.9 calibration tail until the
# matching BK7258 secure packer confirms its runtime-data placement.  It is not
# an authorization to migrate a board or program secure-boot OTP.
